subject: Re: Webinar logistics — registration fields, recording access & stream checks
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: ON24 Support <support@on24.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar launch — registration fields, recording access & stream checks

Hi team,

We’ve locked the date for the AcmeCorp co-hosted webinar (June 18) and I need to confirm a few platform logistics so we can finalize the registration and legal signoff: 

1) Registration form fields — we want: company, job title, company size (bucketed), consent to share recording with partner (checkbox). Can ON24 enforce a required boolean checkbox for “Recording & partner share”? We need it recorded for legal.

2) Recording permissions — recordings must be downloadable by Redwood and AcmeCorp marketing, and embeddable on Impressions page. Can ON24 create separate ACLs for the recording export and generate a download link for both orgs?

3) Stream test windows — we’d like a dry run on June 12 at 10:00AM PT. If ON24’s encoder fails, we’ll fallback to Zoom RTMP/Cloud Recording. Can you confirm the RTMP settings and the expected retention for cloud recordings on Zoom?

4) Panelist controls — panelists will be using local mics + one pre-recorded 10-min demo (MP4). How do you recommend we stage playback so the recording has a single contiguous file?

Attaching speaker_agreement_signed.pdf, slide_deck_v1.pptx, panelist_bios.docx for context.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: ON24 Support <support@on24.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar launch — registration fields, recording access & stream checks

Hi Diego — thanks for the details. Short answers below: 

1) Registration checkbox: yes, ON24 supports required checkbox fields and we can add an explicit consent text. We can also add a hidden field for partner attribution.

2) Recording ACLs: ON24 allows organizer-level and sponsor-level access. We can generate separate download links for Redwood and AcmeCorp. If you need a signed link (time-limited), we can enable expiring tokens. Confirm whether AcmeCorp needs SSO access or just a link.

3) Stream test: June 12 at 10:00AM PT works; we’ll reserve a test studio slot. For Zoom fallback, RTMP stream key and URL will be provided. Zoom cloud recording retention depends on your account plan; for most Event plans we recommend downloading after the event since cloud retention may be 30–90 days.

4) Pre-recorded playback: we suggest uploading the MP4 to the ON24 media library and cueing it from the producer console. If you use local playback through a panelist, the recording may capture it as a separate file; uploading gives a single-file output.

Action items: please confirm AcmeCorp access type (SSO vs link) and confirm the list of panelist emails so we can pre-provision panelist roles.

Best,
Samir Patel
Technical Account Manager — ON24
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, ON24 Support <support@on24.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar launch — registration fields, recording access & stream checks

Thanks Samir — quick answers from our side: 

- AcmeCorp wants SSO into the ON24 console for the recording folder (they’ll need to download and brand the clip).
- Panelist emails (will upload to shared Drive): jane.park@acmecorp.com; robert.kim@acmecorp.com; our moderator: laura_bennett@redwood.com; myself and diego as producers.
- We want the registration checkbox to read: "I consent to Redwood Inference and AcmeCorp sharing the webinar recording and follow-up materials with me." Make it required.

Diego — please confirm you’ll upload the MP4 to ON24 media library by June 10 and confirm who will operate playback during the rehearsal.

Tessa
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, ON24 Support <support@on24.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar launch — registration fields, recording access & stream checks

Confirmed: I’ll upload the MP4 (10min demo) to the Drive and then into ON24 by EOD June 10. Playback operator for the rehearsal will be Laura (laura_bennett@redwood.com); Tessa will be backup.

Samir — for AcmeCorp SSO, do you have our IdP config docs? AcmeCorp uses Okta — they’ll need a SAML assertion to map to sponsor role. If ON24 needs metadata, we can loop in their IT.

Also: please send the RTMP fallback details (URL + stream key) so we can run an end-to-end test with our encoder (vMix).

Thanks,
Diego
From: ON24 Support <support@on24.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jane Park <jane.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar launch — registration fields, recording access & stream checks

Diego/Tessa — quick confirmation following internal ops check: 

• SSO: we can accept AcmeCorp Okta SAML. Please have their IT send us the SP metadata or give us a point of contact; copying Jane Park to start that thread.
• Recording ACLs: we’ll provision a sponsor folder and add AcmeCorp as an org-level viewer with download rights. We will also issue a time-limited signed download link for Redwood (valid 30 days) after we process the recording.
• RTMP fallback: URL=rtmp://backup.on24.com/live ; stream key=ON24-FALLBACK-20250618-XX (we will rotate it post-event). Please run your encoder test during the June 12 rehearsal window.
• Playback: we strongly recommend uploading the MP4 to our media library; producer-stitched recording will be single-file in that case.

We’ve booked the June 12 10:00AM PT test slot for you. If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Technical Account Manager — ON24
P.S. I attached a short checklist in the platform console (link provided in Drive).
